column1: # The video and audio types RVP registers for: the types PotPlayer is
# registered for on the owner's Windows host (its PotPlayerMini64.* ProgIDs,
# read 2026-10-16), without subtitles, playlists, disc files, Flash, its
# bookmarks and .dsf (PotPlayer's skins share it with DSD audio). RVP only
# registers itself as a handler, never as the default (goal J). MIME types
# are shared-mime-info's, newest name first and the older alias after it;
